literal_meaning: মাথার ঘি শুকিয়ে যাওয়া (head's ghee drying up)
figurative_meaning_en: to become devoid of intelligence or lose one's wits
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভয়ে তার মাথার ঘি শুকিয়ে গেছে।
এত চাপে মাথার ঘি শুকিয়ে যাবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: Out of fear, the ghee in his head dried up, leaving him speechless.
Don't let the pressure dry up the ghee in your head.
history: Rooted in Ayurvedic concepts where the brain is metaphorically linked to ghee, symbolizing vitality and intelligence in traditional Bengali folklore.
note: This idiom draws from ancient Indian medical traditions influencing Bengali expressions.
